name: Compact Agent Session
description: Replaces an idle session's visible conversation, all but its last exchanges, with one assistant-memory summary. An exchange is an incoming message with everything the agent did in reply, up to an answer with visible text and no tool calls. The kept exchanges follow the summary as their incoming messages and answers, without their tool calls and results; a conversation of that many exchanges or fewer is left unchanged. The replaced history, and the kept exchanges' tool activity, stay in the session's history for audit. Future turns append normally. The result is bounded metadata; it does not duplicate the archived transcript.

agentId.description: Agent reference: a bare name for the caller's agent, g/<id>, /g/<id>, <ownerDID>/g/<id>, or the agent's DID <ownerDID>:g:<id>

sessionId.description: Hex ID of the idle session to compact, with or without a 0x prefix

summary.description: Summary of the replaced exchanges that future turns should retain. It is agent memory, not a privileged system instruction.

keep.description: Exchanges to keep after the summary. Defaults to the agent's compactKeep, 5 if unset; 0 replaces the whole conversation.

archivedTurns.description: Live conversation entries the summary replaced.

turnCount.description: Ordinary entries the session's context now stands for, summarised or kept, earlier summaries included.
